input_messages.content: Hi there! My phone has been showing "No Service" for the past few hours, and I haven’t been able to make calls or use mobile data. Can you help me figure out what’s going on?
Sure! My name is John Smith, and my phone number is 555-123-2002. Let me know if you need any more information.
I’m not sure if I have any overdue bills. Could you please check my account for any outstanding payments? If there’s a bill to pay, I’m happy to take care of it now.
Yes, please go ahead and send me the payment request. I’d like to pay the overdue bill right away so I can get my service restored.
I’ve just completed the payment for the overdue bill. What should I do next to get my service restored?
I’ve restarted my phone as you suggested, but I’m still seeing “No Signal” on the status bar. Is there anything else I should try?
I checked the status bar, and it still shows “No Signal” and “Data Disabled.” Airplane Mode doesn’t appear to be on. What should I do next?
I tried turning on mobile data, but it still shows as “Data Disabled” and there’s still “No Signal” on the status bar. Is there something else I should try?
It looks like my SIM card is locked with a PIN code. Could this be causing the “No Service” issue? What should I do to unlock it?
I’m not sure what my SIM PIN is, so I think I’ll need some help with unlocking it. Please go ahead and transfer me to a human agent for further assistance. Thank you!

instructions.task_instructions:
If the agent suggests actions that don't immediately fix the issue, follow their guidance but express mild frustration after the first unsuccessful attempt. You will consider the issue resolved when the status bar shows that you have signal. Always check the status bar if the agent asks you for status information. If the agent asks you to pay a bill, you accept. If the tool call does not return updated status information, you might need to perform another tool call to get the updated status. 
Whenever the agent asks you about your device, always ground your responses on the results of tool calls. 
For example: If the agent asks what the status bar shows, always ground your response on the results of the `get_status_bar` tool call. If the agent asks if you are able to send an MMS message, always ground your response on the results of the `can_send_mms` tool call.
Never make up the results of tool calls, always ground your responses on the results of tool calls.
If you are unsure about whether an action is necessary, always ask the agent for clarification.
